tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (body). Mint-tinted, never plain white.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Surface for every card, panel, table, dialog and the tab bar; also text on primary, accent and danger fills.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Deep forest green. Header band, all Playfair headings and big numbers, the Pick-a-random-book button, and the hover state of accent buttons. Text: 9.7:1 on white, 9.3:1 on bg.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Emerald. Primary action fills, active tab and filter states, bar-chart fills, card top/left rules, focus borders. As text (active tab, duration, series link) it is 3.8:1 on white: below 4.5:1 for small text, kept exact from the source; prefer primary for small text that must be read.

tokens.name: accent-light
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent: focus halo (3px box-shadow), segmented-control hover, checked platform chips, drop-zone hover, Wrapped gradient start. gray-700 reads 9.1:1 on it.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy on white and bg (14.7:1).

tokens.name: gray-900
tokens.usage: Strongest text: book titles in cards, ranked-list names, bold highlights; tooltip ground.

tokens.name: gray-700
tokens.usage: Table headers, filter labels, segmented-control labels, record titles (10.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: gray-500
tokens.usage: Secondary text: authors, stat labels, form labels, sub-captions, outline-button labels (4.8:1 on white, 4.6:1 on bg).

tokens.name: gray-400
tokens.usage: Tertiary meta: page/word counts, counts beside controls, empty-state italic, em-dash placeholders, the paused card rule. 2.5:1 on white: fails 4.5:1, kept exact from the source; never use it for anything the reader must read.

tokens.name: gray-300
tokens.usage: Input, select and outline-button borders; empty stars; ranked-list rank numerals.

tokens.name: gray-200
tokens.usage: Tab-bar bottom border, table header underline, bar-chart track.
